result: Implemented bounded Workstream-first resolve_projection validation. ResolveProjectionInput now rejects malformed, orphaned, foreign, or mismatched Work Surface authority before candidate collection, eligibility, or layout; generated CandidateContribution remains scope-neutral and is explicitly bound to the validated Workstream in core; registry collection, eligibility, layout, and no-dead-chrome validation remain core-owned; the emitted projection, Evidence, Receipt, and event all carry the same exact scope.

omitted_contribution_reasons: resolve_projection is a canonical core composition slice with no direct rendered contribution

remaining_checks: The packet's Cargo runtime test remains intentionally unrun because the operator explicitly prohibited Cargo. rustfmt parsing plus the permitted contract, identity, generated-parity, and hostile-source gates pass.
remaining_work: No unresolved CORE-006 source implementation remains. Only the explicitly prohibited Cargo runtime execution is deferred.

CORE-002.decision: Exact Workstream candidate binding and fail-closed eligibility behavior are integrated; only the explicitly prohibited Cargo check is recorded as deferred.

negative_cases.foreign_workstream: A malformed subordinate Attachment owned by another Workstream returns RecompositionError::ScopeMismatch("foreign_attachment_workstream") before eligibility or layout. Exact focus with a different WorkSurface returns ScopeMismatch("work_surface_mismatch") before an unavailable candidate can reach layout.
negative_cases.missing_authority: A focused WorkSurface requires both Attachment authority and the exact scope.work_surface_id. A scope with WorkSurface identity but no Attachment returns ScopeMismatch("attachment_missing"); project_root plus continuity_id is never used as a binding fallback.
negative_cases.stale_revision_cursor: The resolver preserves the supplied durable event cursor and increments projection/layout revisions only after checked overflow validation. Empty cursors and revision overflow fail closed before eligibility; stale partition/cursor ownership remains enforced by CORE-005 persistence optimistic-concurrency gates.
negative_cases.unavailable_capability: Eligibility still owns capability and operation checks. A missing capability becomes a typed omission diagnostic, does not become dead chrome, and does not prevent the remaining eligible contribution from resolving a validated layout.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Profile/activity, meaningful-content, capability, permission, operation, deterministic ranking, and omission behavior remains in resolve_eligibility. resolve_projection calls collect_candidates before eligibility and validate_no_dead_chrome after layout; an all-omitted input remains a typed LayoutError rather than a fabricated placeholder layout.
negative_cases.ambiguous_legacy_row: No legacy project/continuity/session inference or migration was added. CORE-005 remains the canonical persistence/quarantine owner, and its evidence proves ambiguous pre-Workstream rows are retained in quarantine and excluded from canonical reads.

acceptance.statement: Scope mismatch returns typed error before eligibility or layout.
acceptance.proof: ResolveProjectionInput::validate_scope is the first resolve_projection operation. Hostile tests cover foreign focus, orphan WorkSurface authority, and foreign Attachment authority; the failing inputs also contain an unavailable capability so a late eligibility/layout implementation would return a different error.

acceptance.statement: project_root plus continuity_id cannot bind or focus a Work Surface.
acceptance.proof: Focus validation requires exact Attachment-backed WorkSurface authority and an exact scope.work_surface_id match. The orphan-surface hostile test rejects the flattened authority before composition.

acceptance.statement: ambiguous legacy rows are quarantined, not guessed.
acceptance.proof: CORE-006 adds no compatibility resolver or ownership guess. CORE-005's checked-in quarantine implementation and evidence remain the sole migration path, and the central completion DAG remains unchanged.
